chapter.verse: Vanglianpa, Topa ahi Pasian, hong pau a, nisuahna leh nitumna kikal leitung khempeuh a khawm hi.
Hoih kicin’na, Zion panin, Pasian hong taangkhia hi.
Pasian hong pai hi, amah dai om lo hi, ama mai-ah mei husia om a, a kimkotah huihpi om hi.
A mite thu a khen theih nadingin tunglam vantung leh leitung a sam hi.
“Kei tawh biak piakna-in thuciamna a bawlte, ka micitakte ka kiangah hong khawm un!”
Vantung in ama thumanna gen hi, bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian mahmah thukhenpa ahi hi.
“Ka mite aw, ngai un, thu kong gen ding hi, Israelte aw, note’ lang khatah teci ka pang ding hi. Kei in Pasian ka hi a, nomau’ Pasian ka hi hi.
Na biak piakna uh ah note kong mawhsak kei hi; na meihal biaknate uh ka mai-ah om ngitnget hi.
Na inn pan uh-a bawngtal hita leh, na ganbuk pan uh-a keeltal hita leh kong sang kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh gamlak ganhingte khempeuh, mual tul tampite’ tunga ganhingte keima-a’ ahi hi.
Huih lak vasate khempeuh ka thei a, gam lak-a gamta khempeuh keima aa ahi hi.
Ka gil kial taleh zong, no kiangah kong gen kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh leitung leh a sunga om khempeuh keima aa ahi hi.
Bawngtalte’ sa keimah in ne ding ka hi hiam, keelte’ si dawn ding ka hi hiam?
Lungdam biakpiakna Pasian’ tungah pia un la, Sang Penpa tungah na thuciamnate uh bawl un;
haksat hun ciangin kei tungah hong ko un; note kong honkhia ding a, note in kei nong thangsak ding uh hi.”
Ahih hangin migilote tungah Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: “Ka thukhamte lawh nading, ka thuciamna na muk uh tawh gen nading note in bang thu nei na hi uh hiam?
Bang hang hiam cih leh note in hilhna na mudah uh a, ka thute na nunglam uhah na pai uh hi.
Guta khat mu le uhcin ama lawm, na hi pah uh a, numei-pasal mawhna a bawlte tawh na kikhawl uh hi.
Na kam uh, siatna na uksak uh a, na leii un kheemna khang sak hi.
Na tu uh a, na sanggamte langpangin thu na gen uh hi; amaute’ mawhna na zong uh hi.
Hihte khempeuh na gamta khin uh a, bangmah ka pau kei hi; kei pen no tawh a kibangin nong ngaihsun uh hi. Ahih hangin tu in note kong tai a, na mawhna uh na mai uh-ah ka koih hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, Pasian a mangngilh mite aw, hih thu ciamteh un, tua hi kei leh note kong balgawp ding hi, hong honkhia ding kuamah om lo hi.
Biakpiak nadingin lungdam piakna hong paipih mi in kei hong pahtawi ahi hi; Ka thu a mang mite khempeuh ka honkhia ding hi,”
